about: The 1989 cash machine (distributeur automatique de billets) for LF_ATM.et: a free-standing kiosk about 1.9 m tall that stands against a wall on a black plinth. A beige brushed-steel body, a lit header box with a cream sign panel (BANQUE REGIONALE, DISTRIBUTEUR DE BILLETS 24H), a small security camera, a recessed dark fascia with green trim, a green-on-black CRT menu in francs between four side keys each side, a sloped steel shelf with a raised metal keypad (green, yellow and red function keys) and a card reader, a receipt slot, a wide cash slot and a small branch sticker. Built by build.py in headless Blender from simple geometry and procedural textures: no base-game mesh reads as a cash machine (the vanilla Safe_01 it replaced did not) and the CC0 libraries have only a cash register; Meshy is reserved for fish and masks. Core asset: its faces carry period French wording with no place name (map independence, AGENTS.md rule 9), no real bank and no brand. Form after the maintainer's reference picture, 2026-11-22.

layout_m.about: Enfusion metres: x right, y up, z forward; the front faces +z. The ORIGIN is on the ground and the BACK of the kiosk is the plane z -0.30 (as the earlier wall unit and the vanilla Safe_01 before it), so every ATM placed flush to a wall by that plane stays flush.

emissive.about: Materials that also get an _EM map: the sign light box and the screen phosphor.
